writers.name: Kristin Watson
bio: Kristin covers the global economy, from central bank decisions to the small businesses that feel them first. Before joining News 24 she spent six years on a markets desk, translating dense financial data into stories readers can act on.
She is happiest with a spreadsheet open and a source on the phone, and believes every economic story is ultimately a story about people.

writers.name: Marvin Roy
bio: Marvin reports on world affairs and politics, with a focus on climate policy and international negotiations. He has covered summits on four continents and still keeps a notebook for every one.
His reporting has been recognised for its clarity on complex policy fights, and he hosts the occasional live Q&A with readers.

writers.name: Leslie Aria
bio: Leslie leads News 24's editorial direction and writes about art, culture and the creative economy. She founded the publication's arts desk and has commissioned hundreds of features from emerging writers.
When she is not editing, she is visiting galleries and studios in search of the next story worth telling.

writers.name: Hawkings Alex
bio: Hawkings writes about digital publishing, SEO and growing an audience online. He has helped dozens of independent blogs turn into sustainable businesses and shares what works, and what doesn't, in plain language.
He also co-hosts the News 24 podcast on building a voice on the web.

writers.name: Jenny Wilson
bio: Jenny edits the Style section, covering fashion weeks, independent designers and the business of what we wear.
She is particularly interested in sustainable fashion and the makers rethinking how clothes are produced.

writers.name: Daniel Okafor
bio: Daniel covers artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and the companies building the next generation of software.
A former engineer, he likes to read the documentation before the press release.

writers.name: Amara Chen
bio: Amara writes about product design, UX and design systems. She spent eight years designing apps used by millions before switching to writing about the craft full time.
Her guides are known for being practical: every article ends with something you can try the same day.

writers.name: Robert Fox
bio: Robert covers athletics, football and the science of performance. He has reported from three Olympic Games and countless muddy touchlines.
He also writes about health and fitness for everyday athletes.
